summary.text: Doug Campbell is a Republican state senator for Iowa Senate District 30 and has served in the Iowa Senate since January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Campbell, a Mason City businessman, is a retired pharmacist and former Mason City School Board member, according to ABC 6 News reporting on his nomination as the Republican candidate for the seat.
